title: Silk Cloth
wikitext:
{{Stub}}A [[Silk]] [[item]] [[drop]] of usually [[humanoid]] [[mob]]s, not the same as [[Spider's Silk]] or [[Thick Spider's Silk]]. Less common than [[Wool Cloth]], but more common than [[Mageweave Cloth]]. A primary [[ingredient]] of [[Tailoring]] [[recipe]]s, but also used in recipes for [[Blacksmithing]], [[Engineering]], [[First Aid]], and [[Leatherworking]].

''Also a [[Reagent]] for various [[Disguise]]s?''

== Simple Uses ==
Here are some simple uses early on for '''Silk Cloth''':
;Blacksmithing
: [[Solid Weightstone]], 200, for [[Blunt|blunt]] weapons with [[Solid Stone]]
;Engineering
: [[Discombobulator Ray]], 160
: [[Goblin Jumper Cables]], 165
: [[Solid Dynamite]], 175, with [[Solid Blasting Powder]]
: [[Iron Grenade]], 175, with [[Iron]] Bars and [[Heavy Blasting Powder]]
: [[Flash Bomb]], 185, with a [[Blue Pearl]] and [[Heavy Blasting Powder]]
;First Aid
: [[Silk Bandage]], 150
: [[Heavy Silk Bandage]], 180
;Tailoring
: [[Bolt of Silk Cloth]] for use in other recipes
;Reputation
: Hand in 60 Silk Cloth to a faction quartermaster to gain [[Reputation#Reputation_from_Cloth_Quartermasters|Reputation]]
